latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Morning Brief skill.

- Fetches the latest international news headlines from selected RSS feeds.
- Presents a concise, clickable list of news titles, preserving original Markdown links.
- Automatically translates all headlines into Chinese in the brief.
- Easy command-line usage with a Python script and an optional headline limit.
- Requires Python 3.8+ with requests and beautifulsoup4 packages.
